title: DataParade-newsroom and Papyrus-web adopt local CI + LeftBlock receipt gate
description:
Repos: AnthusAI/DataParade-newsroom (private, app d35q7zv4zad2we, main auto-build on), AnthusAI/Papyrus-web (private, app d2scc0rkxkbrhl, main auto-build on). Blocked by the two LeftBlock stories and the app-shell gate story.

Per repo:
1. `.leftblock.yml` `ci.command`: DataParade-newsroom = `npm ci && echo '{}' > amplify_outputs.json && npx papyrus-app sync && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test`; Papyrus-web = `npm ci && npm test` (uses `bin/python.mjs`; document the Python 3.12 requirement). Both add `ci.protected_branches: [main]`.
2. Install the guard: `leftblock install --local --check-only --ci-guard` (name per the LeftBlock story) in each clone; AGENTS.md gets a "Merging to main" section: merge locally, `leftblock ci`, push; never merge in the GitHub UI.
3. `infra/site.json` (DataParade-newsroom has one; Papyrus-web deploys with its own amplify.yml + `bin/deploy.py`): set `ci.gate: leftblock-receipt`; redeploy the app-shell stack (CDK write: ask Ryan). For Papyrus-web, add the same curl gate as the first backend command in `amplify.yml` by hand, since it is not on the app shell; also add `cache.paths` for `.npm/**/*` and `.build/python/**/*` (today it installs Python with dnf and caches nothing).
4. Status posting needs `gh auth status` OK on Ryan's machine for both repos (private: requires repo scope; already true since gh reads them).
Acceptance: a push of a receipted commit deploys; a deliberately un-receipted push to a throwaway branch pointed at the app (or a dry test with `AWS_COMMIT_ID` of a commit without status) fails in <1 min with the message; Amplify job log shows the gate step. Gherkin in each repo's features: "main deploy requires a LeftBlock CI receipt".
